list.name: LoadId
list.label: Lote
list.query: select LoadId from TestLoad where Status = 'Succeeded' order by CreatedAt desc

list.name: Environment
list.label: Ambiente
list.query: select distinct Environment from EnterpriseTechnologyComponent union select distinct Environment from Application order by Environment

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Guia visible para interpretar los cuadros de aplicacion y servicio.

options.content:
### Que muestra
Este tablero conecta aplicaciones con infraestructura: salud, recursos asociados, dependencias criticas, performance end-to-end y riesgo de capacidad por servicio.

### Como interpretarlo
Application Health muestra el estado funcional; Associated Infrastructure muestra que recursos soportan el servicio; Critical Dependencies muestra riesgos que pueden impactar la aplicacion; End To End Performance muestra latencia, throughput y errores.

### Accion sugerida
Si un servicio esta en Warning o Critical, revisar primero Service Capacity Risk, despues Critical Dependencies y finalmente la metrica tecnica que explica la degradacion.

panels.title: Application Health
panels.description: ApplicationId, health, and end-to-end status for service owners.

targets.rawSql: select ApplicationId, ServiceId, Name, Environment, HealthStatus, EndToEndPerformanceStatus from Application where ApplicationId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and Environment ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' order by Name

panels.title: Associated Infrastructure
panels.description: ServiceId, ResourceId, role, and ImpactWeight mapping for each service.

targets.rawSql: select m.ServiceId, m.ApplicationId, coalesce(mr.Name, m.ResourceId) as HostName, c.Environment, m.ResourceId, m.Role, m.ImpactWeight from ServiceResourceMap m left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = m.ResourceId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = mr.Name and c.LoadId = substring(m.MapId from '^(.+)-Map-') where m.MapId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and coalesce(c.Environment, 'Unknown') ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' order by m.ServiceId, HostName

panels.title: Critical Dependencies
panels.description: Warning and Critical dependency risks with service or resource scope.

targets.rawSql: select r.ScopeType, coalesce(mr.Name, r.ScopeId) as HostName, c.Environment, r.ScopeId as ResourceId, r.OverallRisk, r.Reason from RiskAssessment r left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = r.ScopeId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = mr.Name and c.LoadId = substring(r.RiskAssessmentId from '^(.+)-Risk-') where r.RiskAssessmentId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and coalesce(c.Environment, 'Unknown') ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' order by case r.OverallRisk when 'Critical' then 3 when 'Warning' then 2 when 'OK' then 1 else 0 end desc, r.CalculatedAt desc

panels.title: End To End Performance
panels.description: Latency, throughput, and error signals for application-level performance.

panels.title: Service Capacity Risk
panels.description: Service and resource risk context for service-oriented capacity decisions. Missing data means no mapped risk exists.

targets.rawSql: select m.ServiceId, coalesce(mr.Name, r.ScopeId) as HostName, c.Environment, r.ScopeId as ResourceId, r.OverallRisk, r.Reason from RiskAssessment r left join ServiceResourceMap m on m.ResourceId = r.ScopeId and m.MapId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' left join MonitoredResource mr on mr.ResourceId = r.ScopeId left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentName = mr.Name and c.LoadId = substring(r.RiskAssessmentId from '^(.+)-Risk-') where r.RiskAssessmentId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' and coalesce(c.Environment, 'Unknown') ~ '^(${Environment:regex})' order by case r.OverallRisk when 'Critical' then 2 when 'Warning' then 1 else 0 end desc limit 30
